title: TwoFactorResetStatus
description: The status of an in-progress 2FA reset, polled until it reaches a terminal value.

status.description:
The reset status.
| Value | Terminal | Meaning | |-------|----------|---------| | `INITIATED` | no | Reset started; liveness not yet submitted. Keep polling. | | `PENDING_REVIEW` | no | Liveness submitted; under review. Keep polling. | | `LIVENESS_PASSED` | no | Liveness passed; call the complete endpoint to finish the reset. | | `COMPLETED` | **yes** | Reset finished; the lost factor is cleared and re-enrollment can begin. | | `REJECTED` | **yes** | Liveness failed. Stop polling; start a new reset. | | `EXPIRED` | **yes** | The reset window closed before it completed. Stop polling; start a new reset. |
Stop polling on any terminal value.

enrollmentStatus.description: The enrollment status of the replacement factor. `PENDING` until the customer finishes re-enrolling, then `COMPLETED`. Null for an `SMS_OTP` reset, where completing the reset enrolls the new number directly with no separate enrollment step.

expiresAt.description: When the reset window closes. Poll no longer than this.

completedAt.description: When the reset completed; null until then.

ScaFactor.description:
A Strong Customer Authentication factor.

| Factor | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `SMS_OTP` | One-time code sent by SMS to the customer's verified phone. Requires no prior enrollment. |
| `TOTP` | Time-based one-time code from an authenticator app. Requires enrollment. Not valid for per-transaction challenges (cannot carry dynamic linking). |
| `PASSKEY` | WebAuthn passkey assertion. Requires enrollment. |
